# Solvecraft

> Solvecraft is a small software studio that builds custom apps, websites, AI
> agents and automations for small businesses. Every engagement starts with a
> free discovery call around the client's problem, followed by a written
> proposal. We start from the problem, build in early access, and shape
> features around real feedback.

## Key facts

- Services: custom apps, websites, AI agents, automations
- Process: free discovery call → written proposal → early-access build → handover & support
- Early access: clients try working versions early and shape features from real feedback
- AI agents: trained on client data and connected to their tools, with every step reviewable and visible logs
- Payment: advance to start, milestone payments as agreed in writing

## Pages

- [Home](https://solvecraft.dev/): overview of services, process and FAQs
- [Custom Apps](https://solvecraft.dev/custom-apps.html): internal tools, dashboards, client portals, booking systems, MVPs
- [Websites](https://solvecraft.dev/websites.html): fast marketing sites and small stores with solid search basics
- [AI Agents](https://solvecraft.dev/ai-agents.html): support, sales and ops agents with transparent logs
- [Automations](https://solvecraft.dev/automations.html): workflow connections between CRM, invoicing, email and spreadsheets
- [Process](https://solvecraft.dev/process.html): the four-step engagement model
- [Work](https://solvecraft.dev/work.html): real projects we've built
- [About](https://solvecraft.dev/about.html): the team and company principles
- [Contact](https://solvecraft.dev/contact.html): booking a free discovery call
- [Privacy Policy](https://solvecraft.dev/privacy-policy.html): plain-language data handling policy
